goal: A fully functional Arabic-native 2026 electoral intelligence product that exposes the frozen F0 forecast and a separately verified live evidence layer without pretending uncalibrated signals change probabilities.

release_gates.criterion: F0 is displayed from immutable registered artifacts; no UI or pipeline process may rewrite it.
All 92 local constituencies and 12 regions have canonical IDs, Arabic display names, Latin/French display names where evidenced, aliases, and ambiguity-safe matching.
Every surfaced 2026 signal has source class, URL, original-language excerpt or archived content reference, retrieval time, verification status and canonical entities.
Collector query vocabulary and discovery operate natively in Arabic and French; Arabic is never routed through mandatory French translation.
UI distinguishes VERIFIED, PARTY_ANNOUNCED, AMBIGUOUS, UNVERIFIED/NOT_FOUND and DATA_BLOCKED; missing data is not silently filled.
Candidate, nomination, withdrawal/disqualification, alliance, party switch, incumbent/local office and major campaign-event evidence can be ingested under the frozen source policy.
2026 signals are visually and computationally separate from forecast impact. Until E_reason/calibration passes, the UI states that signal impact on F0 is not calibrated.
Daily collection can append a timestamped edition without overwriting prior editions; failures produce explicit stale/data-blocked status.
The frozen E_collect benchmark has been executed and independently evaluated; its result is displayed in the scientific audit trail.

not_required_for_v1: A non-zero forecast impact from 2026 signals
Complete official candidate registration before authorities publish it
post_v1: E_reason determines whether collected evidence contains calibrated predictive information beyond F0. Forecast probabilities change only in a new preregistered immutable snapshot.
